scope: Actual calibration NumPy functions; synthetic zero critic and tensor conversion; no neural inference or games.

unequal_episode_lengths_4_and_5.message: all the input array dimensions except for the concatenation axis must match exactly, but along dimension 1, the array at index 0 has size 4 and the array at index 1 has size 5

exact_critic_counterexample.type: Synthetic mathematical counterexample, not Carbon experiment data.
exact_critic_counterexample.environment: Horizon 299; Phi=0; only terminal reward is an independent fair +/-1 coin, independent of every state/action.
exact_critic_counterexample.critic: V=0 is the exact conditional expected return at every nonterminal state.
exact_critic_counterexample.trajectories: One realized +1 trajectory and one realized -1 trajectory; same length.
exact_critic_counterexample.implication: Large realized GAE/MC difference or correlation below 0.5 alone cannot establish an inaccurate critic, incorrect GAE, or an expected policy-gradient error.
